mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO above 120) signals manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 120, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction activity (HOUST) indicates strengthening housing market and consumer confidence, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low and stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 3.5% with volatility under 0.5%) supports risk asset performance, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
